sentences.en: You may break down your mountain; I will retain it.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它粉碎，但我可以保留它。

sentences.en: If you use a computer, you can retain information.
sentences.zh: 如果你使用电脑，你就可以记住信息。

sentences.en: This town still retains something of the old days.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇仍然保持着往日的气息。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（重新）+tain（拿住）→重新拿回→保留
